items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Have you seen any royalties from Michael Ica? [INTERVIEWEE] No. No, well, not, not, not.

ctx.x: Yeah. So they didn't give you any advance money when you came home. You didn't actually hear some advance money until the check comes or whatever.
Ico, no I don't think so. I was pretty young when I was doing those records. Yeah. So I wasn't really responsible. In fact, I shouldn't have signed a contract. Yeah.
Did you have a contract? Yeah.
